name: Burdock
source:
You've lost your way and nearly lost your life; will your name be enough to buy it all back?

Burdock is a dark and atmospheric fairytale with fae creatures, riddles, and danger abounding. Will you be able to navigate the perils you face and reclaim your life? Or will the mists swallow you up for good...?

[From [url=https://butterflyrocket.itch.io/burdock]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你迷失了前路，还险些丢掉性命；单凭你的名字，足够将这一切悉数赎回吗？

《Burdock》是一部氛围幽暗诡谲的童话风作品，奇异的妖精生灵、扑朔迷离的谜语与四伏危机遍布其中。你能否穿过眼前的重重险境、夺回自己的人生？还是说，弥漫的迷雾终会将你彻底吞噬…？

[摘自[url=https://butterflyrocket.itch.io/burdock]itch.io[/url]]
